title: Speculoos
hookLine: Viral Dutch & Belgian speculoos crafted for mobile Cook Mode & 1-tap Story sharing.

items.name: Softened butter or creamy nut butter
Rich dark brown sugar & salted caramel

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {eu173_but} and {eu173_sug} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Cream Butter-Sugar & Fold Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Cream {eu173_but} and {eu173_sug} fluffy (2 mins), stir in {eu173_flr} and {eu173_flv}. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {eu173_but}, {eu173_sug}, and {eu173_flr} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Bake Golden Edges & Soft Centers
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 11 minutes until edges turn golden while centers look slightly soft. Let Speculoos cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 12 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Cool on the warm sheet for 5 minutes so cookies set into chewy perfection.
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Speculoos to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 12 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
